howto: Tap the monster to hit it; beat it to earn gold and move up a level.
Hire heroes with gold: they attack for you every second, even while you are away.
Every 10th level is a boss. When you have earned enough gold, Ascend for souls that raise your damage by 5% each.
tips: Tap crits hit three times harder.
Friends fight for you every second, even while away.
Bosses have ten times the health and drop twenty times the gold.
Tap the treasure bird when it flies over.
Souls are permanent: spend them in the Ascend tab.

controls.keyboard: Tab to a button and press Enter or Space. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the monster and the hire buttons

difficulty: An idle curve: monsters gain health and pay more gold every level, bosses every 10 levels have ten times the health, and each hero costs 50% more than the last.

features.offline-earnings: Welcome back sheet: earnings while away at 50% (upgradable), up to 8 hours (upgradable), with a Collect button
features.upgrade-tree: Per-building upgrade chains (x2/x3 at 10, 40, 75, 150, 250 owned), tap, helper, income, discount, away-time upgrades that unlock in order, plus x2 milestones at 25/50/100/200 and a permanent perk shop
features.big-number-format: 1.2K, 3.4M, 5.6B and on to Dc, then scientific
features.prestige-or-next-goal: The goal chip under the scene always names the next thing to do; prestige for permanent income with a perk shop
features.tutorial: Coach cards that point at what to tap: tap, build, then keep growing; replay from How to play or the pause menu
features.results: Level-up, welcome back and Ascend sheets
features.progression: Levels unlock tabs and buildings, daily goals with a streak and week stamps, 20 deeds worth +2% income each, level bonus +2%
features.collection: Monster Dex of 30 monsters; every tenth stage is a boss
